channel.title: Pinwei — discover agent skills with taste
channel.description: A daily-restocked shelf of agent skills for Claude Code, Codex and other coding agents — each one with what it actually does, who it is for, and the one-line install command. Skills are picked by hand from public repositories; the shelf favours the ones that are fun or genuinely useful over the ones that merely exist.

item.title: jianming-zhongwen
item.description: Strips filler like "of great significance" from READMEs and error text: modals tiered must/should/may, every term.

item.title: debate-prep
item.description: Both sides prepped: definitions, criteria, arguments, rebuttal bank, and per-format docs in Markdown and PDF.

item.title: playable-prototype
item.description: Stop describing game ideas in words. Drop one in, get several divergent, playable prototypes—each self-contained.

item.title: ip-takedown

item.description: Catches AI tells like 總而言之 & 此外, fixes China-isms and half-width punctuation. For newsletters, support emails.

item.title: comfyui-mcp
item.description: A local-first control plane for ComfyUI — an MCP server plus sidebar agent that generates media, authors and runs workflows, and edits your live graph in plain language.

item.title: trading-design

item.title: sprite-gen
